### New Tashkent is the largest urban development project in the region

![New Tashkent is the largest urban development project in the region](https://newtashkent.uz/uploads/catalog/photo2026-05-0610-36-36-8344a27600.jpg)

![timeicon](https://newtashkent.uz/themes/yangihayot/img/timeicon%20%E2%80%94%20%D0%BA%D0%BE%D0%BF%D0%B8%D1%8F.svg) 06-05-20264824

Samarkand is hosting the largest financial and economic event on the continent - the 59th annual meeting of the Asian Development Bank. It is one of the most important international forums dedicated to development issues in the Asia-Pacific region. Finance ministers of 69 ADB member states, heads of central banks, representatives of the private sector, civil society, academic circles and international organizations are taking part in the event.

The session on the topic of "Non-financial services as a catalyst for the growth of small and medium-sized businesses" , held as part of it, featured a presentation on the "New Tashkent" urban development project. Information was provided about investment opportunities of the region, future forecasts, modern infrastructure solutions and architecture.

More than 100 projects are being implemented in New Tashkent today. In the first phase, the construction of high-rise residences, administrative buildings, business centers, educational and cultural institutions, boulevards and parks is in full swing. The construction of the first stage is planned to be completed by 2033.
